newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-LAMA MISSES PSG PRACTICE ON DAY OF DOPE TEST.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LAMA MISSES PSG PRACTICE ON DAY OF DOPE TEST.

text.p: France goalkeeper Bernard Lama, who faces a possible two-month ban after testing positive for cannabis, missed Paris St Germain's practice on Thursday -- the day his second urine sample was due to be tested.
Manager Ricardo said Lama had been given the day off and stayed behind in Corsica with friends after PSG's league match against Bastia on Tuesday, a 1-1 draw.

French league sources said it could take up to 10 days for the result of the second sample to be published. Lama reportedly underwent a random dope test while he was with the French national team in February.
PSG paraded their new signing, 32-year-old goalkeeper Franck Mantaux of second division Saint-Brieuc, at the practice.
